mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coin_balances (user_id, balance) VALUES (#{userId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = user_id

INSERT INTO coin_transactions ( user_id, transaction_type, amount, balance_after, source_type, source_id, description ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{transactionType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{description} )
mapper.select: SELECT transaction_id, user_id, transaction_type, amount, balance_after, source_type, source_id, description, created_at FROM coin_transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, transaction_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
